description: An experimental native tray companion (macOS menu bar / Windows notification area) lets users manage running AppHosts — view health, open the dashboard, stop instances, and pin favorites — without repeatedly running `aspire ps`. Start it with `aspire tray start`; the CLI supplies a versioned discovery/health stream backing the native frontend. A shared flyout panel with the same layout on macOS and Windows replaces the native menus and dialogs.
name: Experimental tray companion for AppHost management
